Sources.Name: GestPontPro
Sources.Query: SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, '2000-01-01', p.DateDeuxiemePesee) * 100000000 + p.IdPesee AS Wm, p.IdPesee                                   AS SourceId, p.DateDeuxiemePesee                         AS WeighedAt, v.Immatriculation                           AS Plate, v.Produit                                   AS Product, CASE WHEN p.TypeMouvement = 'SORTANT' THEN v.NomClient ELSE v.NomFournisseur END AS ThirdParty, p.PoidsBrut                                 AS GrossKg, p.PoidsTare                                 AS TareKg, p.PoidsNet                                  AS NetKg, p.NumTicket                                 AS NumTicket, p.TypeMouvement                             AS TypeMouvement, v.NomClient                                 AS Client, v.NomFournisseur                            AS Fournisseur, v.CodeClient                                AS CodeClient, v.CodeProduit                               AS CodeProduit, p.NomChauffeur                              AS Chauffeur, p.NumPermisConduire                         AS PermisConduire, p.ImmatriculationRemorque                   AS Remorque, v.NomTransporteur                           AS Transporteur, v.Origine                                   AS Origine, v.Destination                               AS Destination, v.NumCommande                               AS NumCommande, v.Peseur                                    AS Peseur, p.RefactionManuelleKg                       AS RefactionKg, p.PrixUnitaire                              AS PrixUnitaire, p.MontantTotal                              AS MontantTotal, CAST(p.Annule AS UNSIGNED)                  AS Annule, p.MotifsAnnulation                          AS MotifsAnnulation, p.Observations                              AS Observations, p.DatePremierePesee                         AS DatePremierePesee FROM pesees p LEFT JOIN vuepesees v ON v.IdPesee = p.IdPesee WHERE p.Statut = 'TERMINEE' AND p.DateDeuxiemePesee IS NOT NULL AND p.DateDeuxiemePesee < NOW() - INTERVAL 10 SECOND
